name: screen_recall
description: Search what was on the user's screen earlier, from FRED's screen memory (windows he looked at for at least 10 seconds: time, app, window title and the first lines of text). Use it for 'what was I looking at around 3pm', 'what was I doing yesterday afternoon', 'what was that page about X', 'where did I see Y on my screen'. Not the current screen.

query.description: what the page or window was about, in a few words ('lab report', 'flight prices'); leave out when only a time is asked

when.description: when, in the user's words: 'yesterday', 'today at 3pm', 'around 3pm', 'monday', 'last week'; leave out when not said

examples: what was I looking at around 3pm
what was I looking at yesterday
what was that page about physics I had open
where did I see the flight prices on my screen
what was on my screen this morning
what was I doing on the computer yesterday evening
find the page I was reading about the lab report
which window did I have open around noon
not_for: what is on the screen right now (use look_at_screen)
pausing or resuming the screen reading (use screen_watch)
